title: Taqwā and Good Manners
arabic_text: عن [أبي ذرٍّ جُندُبِ بنِ جُنَادَةَ] و[أبي عبدِ الرَّحمنِ مُعاذِ بنِ جبلٍ] رضِي اللهُ عَنْهُما، عن messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قالَ: "اتَّقِ اللهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ".
english_translation: From Abū Dharr Jundub bin Junādah and Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Muʿādh bin Jabal (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhumā), from the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) that he said, 'Have taqwā of Allāh wherever you may be, and follow up an evil deed with a good deed and it will wipe it out, and behave towards the people with good manners.'
description: This Hadith emphasizes three important principles: having taqwā (piety) of Allah everywhere, following up evil deeds with good ones to erase them, and treating people with good character and manners.
